question: As of 2020, which country has the largest proven coal reserves in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The United States of America.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **As of 2020, **The** United States of America** has the** largest proven coal reserves in the world.**
 
• According to data, coal reserves in the United States amounted to** nearly 248.9 billion metric tons.**
 
• The term **"proven coal reserves"** refers to the amount of** coal that can be economically and legally extracted **at the time of evaluation.
 
• Even though **China is the largest consumer and importer** of coal, and it mines almost half of the world's coal, its reserves are not as abundant as those of the USA.
 
• Russia and India, while significant players in the coal industry and having **substantial reserves,** do not have as much proven coal reserves as the United States.
